newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela puts off Banco de Venezuela sale.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela puts off Banco de Venezuela sale.

text.p: The planned privatization of state-owned Banco de Venezuela, due to take place on Friday, has been postponed indefinitely after a series of rumors and confusion led to the withdrawal of bids, a top government official said on Wednesday.

"Due to these conditions, FOGADE thinks it will be impossible to carry out a successful auction and has decided to suspend the auction process," Esther de Margulis, president of state Deposits Guarantee Fund, FOGADE, told reporters.
Margulis said FOGADE would announce "the next steps to be taken in the auction of Banco de Venezuela" as soon as the options have been considered.
The sale of the bank was thrown off course late last week when a local judge ordered the auction to be suspended, while alleged irregularities in the process were investigated.
The same judge reversed her decision on Monday after receiving additional information from FOGADE, but the confusion shook the confidence of potential bidders.
